paper: Automate Strategy Finding with LLM in Quant Investment
headline_agent: GPT-4o factor comparison/selection, 12-alpha learned combination, DNN prediction, and top-13/drop-5 portfolio
headline_component: first paper-selected alpha with exact released formula and signed IC
component_selection_reason: The integrated 12-alpha weights, DNN prediction, and portfolio path are withheld, but Table 3 orders the selected alphas and the source workbook corroborates their signed ICs. PriceMomentum is the first selected row, its exact formula is present in the paper-era source, and its positive IC fixes direction before new JKP inspection.
source_direction: positive from the author workbook signed IC; the unreleased multivariate Table 3 weight is not used

monthly_adapter.bar_mapping: One source daily bar becomes one JKP month; DELAY(CLOSE,14) becomes a 14-month row lag.
monthly_adapter.input: Absolute JKP formation-month prc supplies CLOSE; the literal price difference, not a percentage return, is preserved.
monthly_adapter.universe: Fixed formation-date largest 1,000 U.S. equities from the common JKP contract.
monthly_adapter.portfolio: Researcher-supplied common value-weighted long/short deciles from the source-signed single-factor score.
monthly_adapter.costs: Common 0/5/10/25/50 bp one-way cases with 10 bp primary.
monthly_adapter.missing_returns: Fixed holdings re-accounted under zero and adverse-100 policies without reranking or reweighting.

adapted: daily China bars to monthly U.S. JKP bars
source universe to common U.S. top-1,000
single selected component instead of unreleased 12-alpha DNN combination
common value-weighted deciles, costs, missingness, and JKP133 attribution
